subject: Proposed Changes to RMF-30 Zoning District
comment: Hello, I am writing in regards to the Proposed Rate Increases in Salt Lake City. I have lived in Salt Lake City for more than 10 years. The cost of housing and living and housing has significantly increased in Salt Lake, making housing barely affordable. Studies have been shown, and articles written by Deseret show that an average worker needs to make at least $25/hour to afford housing. That's more than 30% of their income on housing. The fact that housing and cost of living has spiked so much in the past few years, and Utah's minimum wage still remains at $7.25 is a concerning combination for your residents. These are people who can not even afford healthcare themselves, who are living paycheck to paycheck, and who because healthcare workers often don't make the recommended amount for the hourly recommended above. I urge you to raise the minimum wage before you attempt to raise any more increases on any cost of living needs.

subject: City Budget
comment: Salt Lake City Council, I am a constituent on district 6. I am writing to voice my disappointment at the passage of the city budget with the large tax increase. I do support the goals and important initiatives funded by this budget; however, I believe the city should be made to live within their budget. A budget that has increased exponentially every year and has also seen record revenue from the large increase in property values is reckless and sets a dangerous precedent for fiscally irresponsible spending. With record inflation and citizens being required to tighten our belts like city once again is collecting taxes for dubious personnel and projects. I implore you to do better for Salt Lake City residents and be more responsible with your hard earned money. I call on you to be more discerning on those who are making an effort to make wise and good faith decision for the citizens of our city. To date I don't feel like our mayor or anyone sitting on the city council has made these decisions in good faith.
